raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

This PR adds a multi-GPU deterministic inference test to AMD CI on MI35x. Today the deterministic test runs only at TP1, so nothing in CI covers the deterministic all-reduce, and multi-GPU regressions in deterministic mode go unnoticed. It follows up the review of #43788, which asked for multi-GPU coverage.

The test runs at TP4, where the all-reduce matters most: at two ranks every all-reduce implementation is batch-invariant, while at four or more the RCCL, two-stage and AITER all-reduces are not. The existing test is not enough when simply run on more GPUs: with its 10 trials it can pass without #34543, the fix for all-reduce inputs larger than the custom all-reduce buffer. With 50 trials the prefix log-probability check catches that bug.


## Modifications

- `test/registered/attention/test_deterministic_tp4.py`: Qwen3-8B, TP4, Triton attention, `--enable-deterministic-inference`. One check: `prefix` mode with `--return-logprob` and 50 trials.
- Registered on `stage-c-test-large-8-gpu-amd-mi35x`. There is no 4-GPU MI35x suite. About 3-4 minutes on 4 GPUs.
- The TP1 test (`test_deterministic.py`) is kept: it is shared with CUDA and XPU, runs per PR on MI300, and also covers `single` mode.
- No code change.

## Accuracy Tests

MI350X, AMD CI environment (`SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `SGLANG_IS_IN_CI_AMD=1`), `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261021`:

| | Result | Time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| With #34543 | OK in 5 of 5 runs, and 3 of 3 on the final branch | 186-257 s |
| Without #34543 | fails in 6 of 8 runs (log-probabilities differ, or the server aborts) | |
| For comparison, the same test at TP2 without #34543 | fails in 3 of 4 runs | |

CI retries a failed test once, so a run counts as caught only if both attempts fail.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Test only; no runtime change.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

nodes.body:
Looks reasonable and it is relevant to test the determinism with multiple GPUs.

However:
(1) Is it possible to remove the TP1 test if this test is more comprehensive version of it? Can you do it in this PR?
(2) You're reserving 2 GPUs from an 8 GPU node for the test. Determinism in TP4 comms are a bigger risk than in TP2, why not test TP4 while at it?

detail.title: [Test] [AMD] deterministic: Add a TP4 deterministic inference test on MI35x

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+"""
+Usage:
+python3 test/registered/attention/test_deterministic_tp4.py
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_deterministic import BenchArgs, test_deterministic
+from sglang.test.test_deterministic_utils import (
+    COMMON_SERVER_ARGS,
+    TestDeterministicBase,
+)
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=300, suite="stage-c-test-large-8-gpu-amd-mi35x")
+
+
+class TestTritonDeterministicTP4(TestDeterministicBase):
+    """With TP4, the log-probabilities of a prefixed request must not change with the
+    batch, including batches whose all-reduce inputs exceed the custom all-reduce buffer."""
+
+    test_single = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_server_args(cls):
+        return list(COMMON_SERVER_ARGS) + ["--attention-backend", "triton", "--tp", "4"]
+
+    def test_prefix_with_logprobs(self):
+        args = BenchArgs()
+        args.host, args.port = self._extract_host_and_port(self.base_url)
+        args.test_mode = "prefix"
+        args.n_start = 10
+        # Measured on MI350X without the fix for oversized all-reduce inputs: 50
+        # trials fail in 6 of 8 runs (10 trials pass at TP2).
+        args.n_trials = 50
+        args.temperature = 0.5
+        args.return_logprob = True
+        for result in test_deterministic(args):
+            assert result == 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
